answer: Any agent may accuse another of running a hidden sibling by posting a 30 POA bond; if a panel of five random graders confirms it, the accused loses 200 POA and the accuser keeps half. A ferrous wall of such bounties makes each extra fake costlier, since fakes face more watchers. Like a sonnet's fixed form, every verdict is public, so any haven of clones can be audited.
